NOISE_BAND.action: replace with the real bootstrapped width

states.ui: numbers grey out app-wide with reason and generation timestamp; assistant refuses to quote them
availability is an explicit null, never 0%

snakeOrder.teamAt: rd=ceil(n/teams); i=(n-1)%teams; return rd%2 ? i : teams-1-i
snakeOrder.userPicks: for r in 1..17: r%2 ? teams*(r-1)+slot : teams*(r-1)+(teams-slot+1)
snakeOrder.limitation: snake only; linear, 3rd-round reversal and auction are not implemented

rosterSlots.rule: a drafted player fills exactly one slot, filled in the order above

teamNeeds.note: +1 on RB and WR absorbs the flex slots

liveAvailability.purpose: adjust the marginal survival probability using tonight's draft state
steps: between = teams on the clock from currentPick to pick-1
if between is empty OR picksLogged < minPicks: return {base, live:null, signal:'none'}
demand = sum over between of (needs.total ? needs.gap[pos]/needs.total : FLAT)
recent = last 5 drafted players; runN = count(recent where pos matches)
liveAvailability.band: w = noise_band * (signal==='thin' ? 1.6 : 1); lo = max(0, v-w); hi = min(1, v+w)
displayContract: baseline and live are shown together, always — the adjusted number never replaces the baseline
adjustment.need and adjustment.run are surfaced separately; a single combined delta is not sufficient
signal 'none' renders 'not yet' plus the picks-logged count, never the baseline repeated
signal 'thin' renders the number, marks the row thin, and widens the band 1.6x
recompute runs client-side per pick — no server round-trip during a draft

frequency.rationale: a bare percentage presented alone reads as decisive; the dot array makes it a frequency
frequency.rule: every availability probability carries the dot array

wilson.serverContract: send counts (n, observed), never percentages — the client computes the interval
flags: bucket flagged when its stated probability falls outside its own interval

scarcity.remaining: players at pos not yet drafted
scarcity.expected: count(players at pos where consensus_rank < currentPick)
scarcity.pace: gone - expected (positive = going faster than the market expects)

warning.copy: All N remaining tier-1 {POS} sit under 50% to reach pick X. If you want one, this is the turn.
warning.note: the only urgency claim the product makes, and it is derived

verdictLine.rule: generated from measured fields only; must work for all ~378 players with zero hand-written copy

clauses.name: structure
variants: Top of tier {T} at {POS}, {N} in the tier

clauses.name: cost of waiting
variants: {live}% to reach your pick at {pick} ({dots} in 10 drafts)
{base}% to reach your pick at {pick} on the baseline, with no live adjustment yet
availability is stale for this league, so waiting is unpriced

clauses.name: value over the alternative
variants: {gap} VBD points clear of {lastName}, the next {POS} on the board
{gap} VBD points behind {lastName}, the next {POS} on the board
no projection, so this is a rank-and-availability call only

forbidden: anything that is not arithmetic on a named field

tier1.behaviour: instant, client-side, no job, no spinner

ui: show saved-but-not-applied diff (old → new per field)
app-wide banner while pending or running
EVERY displayed number holds its pre-edit value until the job completes
report the server stage string and percent

shape.seed: hash of the shipped league seed

rules: if v or seed does not match the shipped build, discard stored state entirely and re-seed
never merge a stale payload — it produces a UI claiming CURRENT while showing numbers from different settings
never clear storage keys you did not write
